FN-BYBVNJJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 30
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Jeana Ross
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/08/2026
House Bill 30 as introduced could decrease receipts to certain counties and municipalities by an
undetermined amount beginning in Fiscal Year 2027 dependent upon the amount of solid waste
collection fees not collected from certain households whose sole income is veterans' benefits, as
provided by this bill.
